title: Meghalaya: Shillong Dawki Cherrapunji (5N/6D)
overview:
A **5 Nights / 6 Days** road trip from Guwahati through the greenest corner of India: Shillong, crystal-clear Dawki, Mawlynnong (Asia's cleanest village), the Double Decker Root Bridge and Cherrapunji's waterfalls.

Our representative meets you at Guwahati Airport by 11 AM on Day 1 for the drive to Shillong via Umiam Lake. Day 2 takes in Laitlum Canyon, Krang Suri and Phe Phe Falls on the way to a riverside night at Dawki; Day 3 is boating on the Umngot, Mawlynnong and the drive to Cherrapunji; Day 4 is the guided trek from Tyrna to the Double Decker Root Bridge; Day 5 covers the caves and waterfalls of Cherrapunji before returning to Shillong; and Day 6 ends at Guwahati Airport around 2 to 3 PM. Five nights (2 in Shillong, 1 in Dawki, 2 in Cherrapunji), 5 breakfasts and 1 dinner, all road travel, the trek guide and 30 minutes of boating are included. Prices start at ₹20,500 per person on triple sharing, plus 5% GST.
highlights: Krang Suri and Phe Phe Falls
Boating on the crystal-clear Umngot River at Dawki
Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest village, and the Bamboo Sky Walk
Guided trek to the Double Decker Living Root Bridge from Tyrna
Mawsmai and Arwah Caves and the Garden of Caves

itinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong
itinerary.content:
Arrive at Guwahati Airport by 11 AM, where our representative meets and greets you.
Depart for Shillong around 12 PM on a scenic drive, with a photo stop at Umiam Lake (Barapani).
Check in at the hotel, then free time to explore the local market at Police Bazar. Overnight in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Dawki / Shnongpdeng
itinerary.content:
Breakfast at the hotel, then head towards Dawki.
On the way: valley views at Laitlum Canyon, the stunning Krang Suri Falls and the hidden gem Phe Phe Falls.
Reach Dawki / Shnongpdeng, check in and relax by the riverside. Dinner and overnight stay at Dawki.

itinerary.title: Dawki to Mawlynnong to Cherrapunji
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, go boating on the crystal-clear Umngot River (30 minutes included).
Explore Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest village, and walk the Bamboo Sky Walk for views over the Bangladesh plains.
Drive on to Cherrapunji, check in and relax. Overnight in Cherrapunji.

itinerary.title: Double Decker Root Bridge trek
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Tyrna Village and start the trek to the Single Root Bridge.
Continue to the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge and explore the forest around it, then trek back to Tyrna (about 3,300 steps each way, about 6,600 in total; guide included).
Drive back to Cherrapunji and rest. Overnight in Cherrapunji.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji sightseeing to Shillong
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, visit Mawsmai Cave, Arwah Cave and the Garden of Caves.
Viewpoints of Nohkalikai Falls and Seven Sisters Falls, the Mawkdok Dympep Valley and Eco Park.
Drive back to Shillong. Overnight in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Guwahati Airport
itinerary.content:
Breakfast and check-out around 9 AM, then drive through the hills of Meghalaya and Assam (4 to 5 hours, traffic permitting).
Arrive at Guwahati Airport around 2 to 3 PM. The tour ends. Book your return flight after 5 PM.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: At Guwahati Airport. Arrive by 11 AM on Day 1; you are dropped back at the airport around 2 to 3 PM on Day 6, so book your return flight after 5 PM.

faqs.q: How much does the Meghalaya trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular batches: ₹20,500 per person on triple sharing and ₹22,500 on double. 5% GST is extra.

5 nights (Shillong, Dawki and Cherrapunji), 5 breakfasts and 1 dinner, all road travel by tempo traveller, SUV or sedan, the Root Bridge trek guide, 30 minutes of boating at Dawki, all tolls, parking, fuel and driver allowance, and an operations executive on call 24x7.

faqs.q: How hard is the Root Bridge trek?
faqs.a: It is about 3,300 steps each way from Tyrna, around 6,600 steps in total, with a guide. Wear good outdoor shoes.

The ₹8,000 advance is non-refundable under any circumstances.
